request.prompt:
Create FOUR genuine full-body WALK CYCLE KEY POSES of exactly the original cute fire-talisman Taoist boy shown in the eight-direction reference sheet. Output ONLY ONE DIRECTION, specified below, in a TWO-BY-TWO equal-square-cell sheet. Do not output a direction turnaround. Preserve same immense round head, very short compact body/legs, brown spiky topknot and gold red-gem crown, red ribbons, original ornate red-gold flame Daoist robe and ivory cuffs, black short trousers, yin-yang belt and red-gold-black little shoes. Tiny cheerful child-like chibi proportions, not teen/adult.
Anatomical RIGHT hand always holds one red fire-talisman fan; anatomical LEFT hand always holds one engraved brass bell with red tassel, with proper occlusion in this direction. Exactly one fan and one bell per boy, no swapping or duplication. Fixed identical view direction throughout.
FOUR PHASES in row-major order:
TOP LEFT frame01 = RIGHT CONTACT: right leg reaching forward along travel direction to heel contact, left trailing toe on ground heel raised. Right fan arm slightly BACK, left bell arm slightly FORWARD (opposite limbs).
TOP RIGHT frame05 = RIGHT SUPPORT / LEFT PASSING: right foot planted beneath body, LEFT knee flexes and left shoe is airborne passing the planted right leg. Arms swing near neutral at sides. Feet closer than in contact.
BOTTOM LEFT frame09 = LEFT CONTACT: LEFT leg reaching forward to heel contact, RIGHT leg trailing heel raised. Opposite support and leg overlap to top-left. Right fan arm slightly FORWARD, left bell arm slightly BACK.
BOTTOM RIGHT frame13 = LEFT SUPPORT / RIGHT PASSING: LEFT foot planted beneath body, RIGHT knee flexes and right shoe is airborne passing support leg. Arms near neutral, opposite support leg and near/far overlap to top-right.
Make contact and passing visibly distinct. Clear coherent two legs and two shoes, always one foot grounded; no floating leap, extra limbs, cross-legged pose or repeated same forward leg. Gentle natural coat hem, ponytail, prop and tassel motion but stable head/costume scale. Full body including hair, props and shoes wholly inside each exact equal quadrant. Hair top at5% of own cell, planted-foot baseline95%, width comfortably within cell. Same scale across four cells, bottom-row hair strictly below full-sheet horizontal middle, no overlap/clipping.
Completely opaque FLAT PURE #FF00FF magenta background. No floor, cast shadow, gradients, particles, labels, text, numbers, grid lines or borders. Clean polished HD hand-painted Chinese fantasy chibi game art.
REQUIRED VIEW: FRONT THREE-QUARTER facing lower-left / SOUTH WEST, diagonally toward viewer and image LEFT. Use the BOTTOM ROW SECOND reference sprite. Both eyes and front torso visible, nose angled image-left. Anatomical LEFT arm on near camera side carries the BRASS BELL; farther RIGHT arm carries RED FAN. Exact identity and prop ownership from reference. Keep this view, do not turn straight front or profile.
